name: Coercion
overview: The Scriptures reveal that coercion often arises in the context of religious demands, as seen when Nebuchadnezzar established a golden image requiring worship (Daniel 3:1) and when exclusive allegiance to the LORD was enforced with severe consequences (Exodus 22:20). Yet, God’s sovereign power is affirmed through His protection and deliverance of His faithful servants, exemplified by Daniel’s rescue from the lions' den and the decree recognizing the living and everlasting God (Daniel 6:26-27). These passages highlight the tension between human-imposed coercion and God’s ultimate authority and deliverance.
